notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Tentacles.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Carnage Altar by paying {3} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
